chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى عُبَيْدُ ٱللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْحَلَبِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ قَالَ:

translations.en: ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَزُورَ ٱلْبَيْتَ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ

translations.en: I asked him about a man who forgot to visit the House until morning came.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ أَنَا رُبَّمَا أَخَّرْتُهُ حَتَّى تَذْهَبَ أَيَّامُ ٱلتَّشْرِيقِ وَ لَكِنْ لَا يَقْرَبِ ٱلنِّسَاءَ وَ ٱلطِّيبَ».

translations.en: He said: “There is no harm. I myself sometimes delayed it until the days of Tashrīq had passed, but he must not approach women or perfume.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who delays the visitation of the Kaʿbah during hajj after forgetting it until morning. The delay is not considered harmful, but certain restrictions remain in force, including refraining from women and perfume until the rite is completed.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Ṭawāf al-Ziyārah until the morning during hajj?

key_terms.يَزُورَ ٱلْبَيْتَ: to perform the visitation of the Sacred House, meaning the required hajj visitation rite
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal problem in this situation
key_terms.أَيَّامُ ٱلتَّشْرِيقِ: the days of Tashrīq following ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā during the hajj period
key_terms.ٱلنِّسَاءَ: women, meaning conjugal approach remains prohibited
key_terms.ٱلطِّيبَ: perfume or fragrance, which remains prohibited here
